responsibility: Public C interface for GNAT Ada-name decoding utilities. It declares the routines that convert encoded external/debugger names back to Ada source-style names and that extract embedded GNAT type encodings, providing a reusable boundary for tools or runtime code that need to interpret GNAT symbol naming without depending on Ada sources directly.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface member of the adadecode pair: it only publishes the small C API for __gnat_decode and get_encoding, with no decoding logic. Unlike gcc/ada/adadecode.c, it serves as the reusable declaration boundary that callers include to access those name-decoding services.
